body:
* Are you reporting a bug, or opening a feature request?
```
bug - mypy INTERNAL ERROR
```
* Please insert below the code you are checking with mypy,
  or a mock-up repro if the source is private. We would appreciate
  if you try to simplify your case to a minimal repro.
```
import ctypes
buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer ( 64 )
s = buf.value.decode ( 'ascii', 'replace' )
```

```
mypy_internal_error.py:3: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues version: 0.650+dev.3ad628d797defcbd892dede48151c8e390f45258
```

```

```
